description: Check a certificate, and optionally its key, chain and CRL, and report structured findings (severity, code, message). Exits 0 whenever the checks ran; the caller decides whether a finding fails or only warns

cert_path.description: Path to the certificate to check (PEM or DER)

key_path.description: Path to the private key (PEM or DER; RSA, EC or Ed25519). When given, the key must match the certificate

chain_path.description: Path to a PEM bundle of intermediate and root certificates. When given, the certificate is verified against it

crl_path.description: Path to a certificate revocation list (PEM with a BEGIN X509 CRL header, or DER). When given, the CRL is checked for staleness, issuer and revocation of the certificate

warn_days.description: Report a warning when the certificate expires within this many days (default 30)

key_passphrase.description: Passphrase for an encrypted private key
